scenarios.title: Data events
scenarios.behavior: Enable registers an inclinometer ReadingChanged listener and streams pitch/roll/yaw; Disable stops it and is disabled until Enable succeeds. Hardware-gated: shows 'No inclinometer found' without a sensor.

scenarios.title: Polling
scenarios.behavior: Enable starts a timer polling GetCurrentReading at a set interval; Disable stops it and is disabled until Enable succeeds. Hardware-gated identically.

scenarios.title: Calibration
scenarios.behavior: Selecting an accuracy simulates sensor accuracy; 'Unreliable' invokes the calibration bar. Hardware-gated identically.

gradingRules.pass: reachable non-empty page AND >=80% baseline control coverage AND no behavioral regression vs UWP golden
gradingRules.partial: >=40% coverage OR a control present but DEAD relative to a responding UWP control
